summary: All 23 SR requirements implemented in 9 Java files under sranger/; 7 points the requirements did not settle are recorded below.

issues.title: Sensor no-reading distance is 1000.0 m
issues.raw: SR-DM5 requires a 'large default value' when no reading is available but gives no number. Chosen: 1000.0 m (Sensor.NO_READING_DISTANCE), far above obstacleThreshold. A negative or NaN measurement passed to update() is also treated as 'no reading'.
issues.fix_directive: None unless the requirement fixes a value; change NO_READING_DISTANCE if so.

issues.title: Initial values of clockResetTime and the actuator's stored command
issues.raw: clockResetTime starts at 0.0 (it is always reset on entry to Turning before the Turning guard reads it). The Actuator's stored lv/av start at 0.0 before the first command; the constructor immediately overwrites them with Move(moveVel, 0).
issues.fix_directive: None; the values are never observed by a guard before being set.

issues.title: Power-up entry action of Moving is issued in the constructor
issues.raw: SR-FR1/SR-Beh1: Moving is initial and its entry issues Move(moveVel, 0). With entry actions written inline on each branch of step(), the power-up entry has no branch; the constructor issues it. The extracted model's initial transition may therefore carry no action.
issues.fix_directive: None unless the model must show the initial Move.

issues.title: Moving -> Turning needs the obstacle event and obstacleDetected
issues.raw: SR-Beh2 names the obstacle event as trigger; SR-GP1 names obstacleDetected (distance <= obstacleThreshold) as the guard of the same transition. Both are used: trigger obstacle, condition obstacleDetected.

issues.title: Tick self-loops perform no action; Turning priority endTask > timeout > tick
issues.raw: SR-Beh4/SR-Beh7 say the tick self-loops perform no action, so the branches do not re-issue Move. In Turning, endTask is first (override), the autonomous turnDurationElapsed transition second, and the tick self-loop last with '&& !turnDurationElapsed' so that the timeout is not masked by the per-cycle tick.

issues.title: obstacleThreshold 0.5 is fractional; the model constant rounds it up to 1
issues.raw: SR-DM2 fixes obstacleThreshold = 0.5 m. The model's constants interface rounds fractional constants up to an integer, so the model guard reads distance() <= 1 while the Java tests distance() <= 0.5. moveVel, turnVel and turnDuration are whole numbers and unaffected.
issues.fix_directive: The exact value matters to the SR-GP1 guard; the verified model over-approximates the obstacle condition.

issues.title: Final ignores all events
issues.raw: SR-FR3 makes Final terminal and no requirement gives it a transition, so its mode block is empty (time still passes in the model). The Clock is a separate class (field 'timer', since 'clock' is reserved) advanced by the framework.
